description: This file defines reference counting base classes, traits, and smart pointer templates for managing object lifetime in a thread-safe manner, including classes like RefCounted, RefCountedThreadSafe, and scoped_refptr.

classes.name: RefCounted
classes.description: A non-thread-safe reference counted base class for objects, requiring derived classes to have private destructors.

classes.name: RefCountedThreadSafeBase
classes.description: A thread-safe base class managing reference count with atomic operations.

classes.name: RefCountedThreadSafeTraits
classes.description: Default traits for thread-safe reference counting, defining how to destruct objects.

classes.name: RefCountedThreadSafe
classes.description: A thread-safe reference counted class template that manages object lifetime with customizable traits.

classes.name: RefCountedData
classes.description: A thread-safe wrapper for data, enabling reference counting of the contained object.

methods.name: HasOneRef
methods.description: Checks if the reference count is exactly one.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and deletes the object if count reaches zero.

methods.name: Destruct
methods.description: Deletes the object, can be overloaded for custom destruction behavior.

methods.name: DeleteInternal
methods.description: Internal method to delete the object, used by traits.
